basis: O-valve invalidation: a source INVALIDATE retracts the retained output; a control INVALIDATE alone leaves the control without a value, which closes the valve

basis: O-pause invalidation: an INVALIDATE of the lock state leaves it without a list, which holds no lock: every held array is released in one wave, each as it arrived; with nothing held the output sent before stays

name: a lock state that is given the empty list and completes in one wave releases what was held, and holds no lock afterwards

name: a restored pausable whose last lock was released while the graph was saved sends the array of two it held as it arrived, and nothing of its unchanged source after it

name: the held inner's INVALIDATE retracts concatMap's output and the inner keeps its slot: the waiting value still waits, and the INVALIDATE of a node whose value waits retracts nothing
basis: O-concatMap invalidation: the held inner's INVALIDATE retracts the output and the inner keeps its slot

name: a restored concatMap keeps its held inner, the outer values that waited in order and that its outer completed: it sends nothing for what it had received, starts the waiting values in turn, and ends when the work is done

name: a concatMap that deactivates forgets its held inner and what waited: at its next activation it starts the inner of what the outer holds then

name: an outer value that exhaustMap ignores is not projected: a projector that throws on it does not end exhaustMap while an inner is held, and ends it, without that wave's DATA, when the value arrives with none held
